lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters are visible along the mid-lateral flank and posterior peduncle; three distinct blobs form a triangular arrangement near the ventral-posterior section of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with faint horizontal light-intensity bands to form a grid, with high-luminance circular nodes positioned at the grid intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transitioning from light on the upper edge to deep shadow on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant semi-circular indentation or notch is visible on the upper posterior margin of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The upper lobe of the caudal fin exhibits a distinct V-shaped notch on its trailing margin.
